actionConfiguration.body:
INSERT INTO stock_movements (
    company_id,
    warehouse_id,
    product_id,
    document_id,
    document_item_id,
    movement_type,
    movement_date,
    quantity,
    unit_cost,
    total_cost,
    note
)
VALUES (
    {{appsmith.store.companyId}},
    {{this.params.warehouseId}},
    {{this.params.productId}},
    {{this.params.inventoryCountId}},
    {{this.params.documentItemId}},
    'ADJUSTMENT',
    NOW(),
    {{this.params.varianceQuantity}},
    {{this.params.unitCost || 0}},
    {{this.params.totalCost || 0}},
    {{this.params.note || null}}
);
